<!-- pr-reviewer: 8751fc52ab6cf4215607dc7773a4ebe2a6d5e297 -->

Needs changes before merge. Two review threads are open on this head: one by a collaborator (four findings, also quoted below) and this review, which adds one more finding and endorses the four that are already on the PR.

**What looks good**

- The kinematics are a faithful mirror of the gate's posed-steel law, not a re-derivation with a wrong sign: the turn is the same signed Rodrigues turn (`upright_turn`, `turn_about`, `crates/sim/src/verify/posed_steel.rs:306-314` and `333-344`, vs `crates/app/src/sim_machine_view.rs:50-77`), and the line the timeline carries is the same line the gate judges with (`crates/app/src/fixture.rs:255` via `fixture::rotary_axis_of`, called from `shell::work_turn_of`).
- The fallback is honest and explicit: no line, degenerate direction, leaning line, or a pose that cannot stand upright reads as `None` and keeps today's tip-relative draw, bit for bit (`sim_machine_view.rs:16-18`, `world.rs:344`). No guessed picture.
- The seven unit tests pin the gate's sign (a -Y pose over a +X line stands upright under t = -quarter turn, `sim_machine_view_tests.rs:22-30`), points on the line stay put, radii hold, the tool rides the carried tip, and the fallback keeps the old picture.

**Results merged with main** (trial merge of current origin/main 9b141e112)

- Trial merge: clean (`git merge --no-ff --no-commit origin/main`, "Automatic merge went well"). No conflicts.
- `cargo check -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets` on the merged tree: clean (2m19s, -j 6).
- camcraft-sim --lib: 281 passed, 0 failed (re-verified on the merged tree).
- camcraft-app --lib: 326 passed, 0 failed (re-verified on the merged tree).
- camcraft-ui --lib: 1717 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored (earlier run on the afca9b8b trial merge; not re-verified on the current merge — the run hit a 570 s timeout under machine contention with another heavy build, not a test failure. No failures were reported; no failure text to quote).
- clippy (sim/app/ui, `--all-targets -- -D warnings`): clean (earlier run on the merged tree).
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`): 6 steps green (11 light tests, wall 6.2 min) — earlier run on the merged tree.
- No test failure text to quote; all green.

**Targeted tests**

- No post or toolpath change: no example catalog suites owed.
- The PR's pinning tests (`sim_machine_view`, 7 tests) ran green.
- Light lane green (above).
- No heavy step owed: this is a P3 display fix, not a P1 under the safety floor.
- The PR changes no fixtures, importer, post or catalog; no golden PNG moved.

**Requested before merge** (one rule per class)

1. Class: missing sim-level pinning test. The PR body claims "camcraft-sim: `Frame` carries `work` through `Script::at` (all 5 windows), default `None`" (`crates/sim/src/sim.rs:300-371`). No test in the diff pins any of the 5 arms; the `Frame`-threading claim is unverified. Rule: every new behaviour stated in a PR body is pinned by a test in the diff. Add one sim test that builds a small script, then asserts `Script::at` carries `work` through the empty-script window, `t <= 0`, `t >= total`, the mid-move window, the dwell window and the past-window/`done` window.
2. Class: wrong playback of fixed steel. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/world.rs:218` turns every visible model vertex, including fixtures with `FixtureDef.fixed == true`. The gate keeps fixed steel in the machine frame (`crates/app/src/fixture.rs:192-205`). One rule: apply a work-side membership rule before each scene transform - the part, the stock and the turning-side steel turn; fixed fixtures and the machine table stay. Add a scene test with one turning fixture and one fixed fixture.
3. Class: inconsistent display frames. `world.rs:344` moves the tool body to the carried tip, while the tool marker uses the original `f.pos`/`f.axis` (`shell.rs:396`), the path overlay keeps original coordinates (`world.rs:412`, `interact.rs:998`), and the shadow shape is built from the unturned `ModelSrc` (`world.rs:191`, 219). Rule: one display transform per work-side scene element and the corresponding tool marker; machine-side elements stay fixed. Test the marker, path, model and shadow together at a nonzero rotary pose.
4. Class: frame-cache law. `world.rs:383-385` turns every vertex on every collection; a paused playhead re-turns the same geometry. This breaks upstream `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`, "Frame cost": a still frame computes no derived geometry again, and the cache key is never `doc_version` alone. Rule: cache transformed geometry by its actual inputs (or apply the transform in the draw stage). Add the still-frame counter test and a changed-input test.
5. Class: crate-placement law. `crates/app/src/sim_machine_view.rs:30` imports only `WorkTurn`. The new module operates only on vectors, angles and vertices; it reads none of the five document concerns. This breaks upstream `AGENTS.md`, "app holds the document, nothing else". Rule: new code that works only on domain values lives in the crate that owns the domain. Move this math and its unit tests to `camcraft-sim`, and re-export the API from `app` for the UI.

**Questions / notes**

- The machine grammar does have a `pivot` field for rotary axes (#1962, `crates/post/src/machine/def.rs:93-95`). The PR doc note (`sim_machine_view.rs:16-18`) says a head has no gauge-line pivot stated in the machine file. For heads that is accurate - a head is spindle-side and no shipped machine states one. If a follow-up is expected to draw head stations, it will want the head's `pivot` read too. Not blocking.
- `world.rs` grew from 374 to 414 lines (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/world.rs`); the 400-line shape rule is a flag, not a blocker. Consider a split when the scene code changes again.
- The `sim_machine_view` `upright_turn` unitizes the pose axis (`sim_machine_view.rs:52`); the gate reads a raw pose and checks `dot3(a, d)` directly (`crates/sim/src/verify/posed_steel.rs:306-314`). Equivalent for normalized poses; the PR is strictly more robust. Fine.
- Structure: the PR adds no new top-level test binary, no dependency lines, no `docs/decisions/` entry, no snapshot PNG change; no `AGENTS.md`, process or script files touched.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
